en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small harbor packed with wooden fishing boats and boathouses along the water. Traditional wooden houses climb a rocky hillside in the background, typical of a Scandinavian coastal village. In the lower left the printed caption reads "HUNNEBOSTRAND." and in the lower right there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 5415.
